recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure in crisp white streetwear and a fedora, leaning against a massive wall of black subwoofers. The scene features high-contrast lighting, metallic accents, and bold, graffiti-inspired typography integrated with musical elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in white against a dark, industrial speaker background
Graffiti-style text interacting with a microphone icon
Circular speaker cones echoing the curves of the subject's hat and accessories
Vertical orientation of the subject balanced by the stacked horizontal speaker grid
coreInvariants: Wall of large black speaker cones
High-contrast white clothing against dark background
Graffiti-influenced lettering with thick black outlines
Metallic jewelry and belt buckle highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central full-body or three-quarter shot, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and white fedora, positioned in the upper-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright hat down the white jacket to the metallic belt, then up to the bold typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with speaker textures and the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark charcoal (speakers and shirt).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white (jacket, pants, hat, and text fill).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and silver (jewelry, belt buckle, microphone mesh).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between the white highlights and black shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Monochromatic base with metallic accents only

letterConstructionRules: Heavy black outer stroke with white inner fill
Sharp, aggressive angles mixed with rounded bulges
characterSpecificRedesigns: Integration of a microphone icon into the letterforms
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold decorative style to maintain urban focus.
graphicDevices: Microphone icon as a vertical divider

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the urban hip-hop energy of the original.
Provides a similar bold, street-inspired weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-detail photograph of a young man in a white streetwear jacket, white fedora, and black t-shirt, leaning against a wall made entirely of large black professional audio speakers and subwoofers. High contrast lighting, urban studio setting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom graffiti-style vector lettering in the top right corner. Use a thick black outline and white fill. Integrate a stylized microphone graphic into the text layout.

verificationChecks: Is the contrast between the white clothing and black speakers sharp?
Does the text have a thick, bold black outline?
Are the speaker cones clearly visible as a textured background?
Is the lighting dramatic and directional?

adjustableVariables: Number of speakers in the wall
Text placement (top left vs top right)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact letter shapes of the original name
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white jacket doesn't lose detail in the highlights.
Check that the speaker wall looks like a physical structure, not a flat pattern.
Verify the typography feels integrated into the urban theme.
Confirm the metallic elements have a realistic sheen.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast fashion subject in monochrome white with a repetitive industrial background (like speakers or tires) and top it with heavy-outline graffiti display type.
